comment: Differences between Chromium 156 and WebKit that tests/abi/host_string_nul.py asserts at the WebKit value. Each WebKit value holds the whole input, so it differs from the value a NUL-terminated input would give.

T8.reason: Document.title strips and collapses ASCII whitespace, which excludes U+0000: WebKit keeps it; Chromium reads 'a b'.

L1.reason: CSS Syntax input preprocessing replaces U+0000 with U+FFFD, which WebKit applies to the custom property value; Chromium keeps U+0000.
